en.headline: CFS finds excessive aflatoxin in bottled pistachio paste, orders recall
en.dek: A sample of Naturalam 100% Pure Pistachio Butter sold at Sogo contained 12 times the legal limit; the public is advised not to consume the affected batch.
body: The Centre for Food Safety today advised the public not to consume a bottled pistachio paste product after a sample was found to contain an excessive level of aflatoxin. The product is Naturalam 100% Pure Pistachio Butter, 110 grams, best before 16 April 2027, originating from the mainland and sold at Sogo Fresh Mart.

Under the routine Food Surveillance Programme a sample taken from a Causeway Bay supermarket tested at 120 micrograms of aflatoxin per kilogram, against the legal maximum of 10 micrograms per kilogram for other foods under the Harmful Substances in Food Regulations.

The CFS has instructed the retailer and distributor, Master Lam Foods Ltd, to stop sales, remove the affected batch from shelves and begin a recall. Consumers may call the distributor’s hotline 2763 9596 during office hours for recall details. Aflatoxins are natural toxins classified as carcinogenic to humans by the International Agency for Research on Cancer.

zh.headline: 食安中心驗出開心果醬黃曲霉毒素超標 指令下架回收
zh.dek: 天然之林純開心果醬樣本每公斤含120微克黃曲霉毒素，超法定上限11倍，市民應停止食用受影響批次。
body: 食物環境衞生署食物安全中心今日公布，一款瓶裝開心果醬樣本被檢出含過量黃曲霉毒素，呼籲市民停止食用受影響批次產品。產品為天然之林純開心果醬，淨重110克，此日期前最佳為2027年4月16日，來源地為中國內地，零售商為崇光超市。
中心透過恆常食物監測計劃在銅鑼灣一間超級市場抽取樣本，結果顯示每公斤含120微克黃曲霉毒素，較《食物內有害物質規例》規定任何其他食物可容許最高濃度每公斤10微克超出11倍。
中心已指令零售商及總代理林師傅食品有限公司停售、下架及展開回收。市民可於辦公時間致電總代理熱線2763 9596查詢回收事宜。黃曲霉毒素已被國際癌症研究機構確認對人類致癌。
